title_zh: 核对落地后的取车时间和出口路线

scenario.label_zh: 确认航班后取车及机场出口路线
scenario.goal_zh: 核对取车所需驾照、柜台开放时间和车道，并约定停车后再设置导航

context_zh: 英国机场租车柜台工作人员露丝与即将到达的旅客伊万通电话；不实际预订车辆。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Ivan
sentences.text: My flight is due in at six. How long after landing should I allow before collecting the car?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: You need time for baggage collection. Our desk stays open until ten, so there's no need to rush.

sentences.speaker: Ivan
sentences.text: I'll bring the booking confirmation. Do you need my driving licence as well?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Yes, the original, please. We'll check the other documents listed in your confirmation when you arrive.

sentences.speaker: Ivan
sentences.text: Is the road out of the car park difficult? I won't know the navigation system yet.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Stay in the left lane for the airport exit. There's a marked stopping area just beyond the barrier.

sentences.speaker: Ivan
sentences.text: Can I park nearby while I set the route? I'd rather not work it out while driving.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Use that marked area. Set everything up there before you join the main road.

sentences.speaker: Ivan
sentences.text: Right. I'll collect my bags, come to your desk, and set the route before leaving the airport.
